summary.text: Jarett Gandolfo is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly, representing District 7 since January 2021, and the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jarett Gandolfo lives in Sayville, New York, and graduated from West Islip High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from the State University of New York at Albany in 2013 and an M.P.A. from Villanova University in 2018.
Gandolfo assumed office in the Assembly on January 1, 2021, succeeding Andrew Garbarino, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as including Alcoholism and Drug Abuse, Higher Education, and Racing and Wagering.
In the State Senate District 8 general election he faces Democrat Josh Taveras.
